title: Projection Revisioning / Monotonic Cursor Hardening
donor_semantics: Titan Zero v0.6.13 Projection Cursors — semantic extraction only; no stale-line overlay
rules: Server component revisions/cursors are tracked independently.
Lower component revisions cannot overwrite newer component state.
Equal revision with different cursor or data is a conflict and fails closed.
Equal revision with identical state is idempotent.
Unversioned updates cannot overwrite already-versioned component state.
Local sync generation rejects older refreshes that finish after newer refreshes.
